text:
leo: Heads-up - had a customer flag where an inbound prompt leaked PII in logs. Thinking we need an \"emergency scrub\" toggle in console/router to instantly stop storing unredacted samples for a tenant.

sara: agreed. two immediate Qs: 1) toggle should be global per-tenant or per-route? 2) what does it do to in-flight messages?

leo: propose per-tenant hard-stop that flips storage=false and routes future samples into ephemeral only. in-flight: mark for async purge and stop downstream retention.

gina: for UX, make it a red button with confirmation modal saying \"this will stop all audit capture + purge ephemeral blobs\" and require 2FA. also surface who clicked it and timestamp.

devops-bot: FYI - incident template 'emergency-scrub' created and attached to this thread.

ops: we should ensure toggle doesn't break quota enforcement. if samples are diverted to ephemeral, quota accounting must still decrement so rate limits stay accurate.

sara: agree on quota. also need a policy about charging customers - emergency scrub should never reduce their billed tokens, but platform should swallow audit-capture costs.

leo: +1. ledger events unchanged. audit copies get marked `audit:internal` and go to an internal budget. finance already ok with pegging a small reserve.

legal: quick note - any feature that purges data must log the purge action immutably and require a legal case id for rehydration. also escaping purge via backups is a compliance risk.

gina: ok will add an immutable purge log entry to the runbook. UI also shows case-id entry required before purge.

ops: implementation detail - router will set header `x-scrub-mode: emergency` and ingestion will drop storage writes. we'll also emit metric `scrub.emergency.{tenant}` and alert if set > 0 for >5m.

sara: what about embeddings / vector stores? If ephemeral path still generates embeddings, they could leak. Recommendation: emergency-scrub also disables derived artifact creation (embeddings, reranks) or stores only redacted-derived artifacts.

leo: prefer disable by default. we can have a config `scrub.emergency.allow_derived: false` so it's explicit.

ops: runbook step: when toggle is used, pager team get auto-cc'd, and a short audit will run to ensure purge succeeded. ops-bot will post results to thread after purge job completes.

devops-bot: Scheduled job 'purge-check' created and will post status back.

gina: small UX ask - show a readonly historical map of when emergency-scrub was active per-tenant for last 90 days. legal + audits rely on this.

legal: +1. also require retention of the anonymized metadata (no content) for up to 1 year for compliance.

sara: rollout plan: feature gated behind flag `emergency_scrub` for a week in staging, then enable for 10% of tenants (opt-in) in prod, with an operations-only access control.

leo: I'll draft the PR for router header + metric emit. ops can stub the purge job. Gina will wire UI mocks. assigning follow-ups.

ops: noted. I'll add ACL check in infra for the button and lock weekend usage by default.

gina: mock ETA EOD tomorrow.

leo: cool, thanks all. let's keep thread for follow-ups.
